content:
Cancelling an active reservation releases its cash and quota occupancy. It neither creates cash nor changes `expires_minute`.

Released capacity can support a current conversion only while its validity interval still covers execution. A quote does not extend the interval. Historical allocation amendments use their own tests against the original conversion date and the amendment date.
